stem.text: The molecular formula $\text{CH}_3$ can represent an anion, a cation or a free radical. Species with the molecular formula $\text{CH}_3$ can act as an electrophile, a free radical or a nucleophile depending on the number of outer shell electrons on the central carbon atom.
How many outer shell electrons on the central carbon atom must be present for $\text{CH}_3$ to act in these different ways?
